# MDS plot
```{r}
cancer_counts <- read.table(file="oral_carcinoma_counts.txt", sep = "\t", header = T)
head(cancer_counts)
convert_to_DGE_list <- DGEList(counts=cancer_counts[,3:8], genes=cancer_counts[,1:2])
##BiocManager::install("edgeR")
rownames(convert_to_DGE_list$counts) <- rownames(convert_to_DGE_list$genes) <- convert_to_DGE_list$genes$EntrezGene

convert_to_DGE_list$genes$EntrezGene <- NULL

## calculate scaling factor
sf <- calcNormFactors(convert_to_DGE_list)

sf$samples$group = c("N", "T", "N", "T", "N", "T")

# MDS plot
plotMDS(sf)
```

## BCV plot
```{r}
sf <- estimateDisp(sf)
sf$common.dispersion
#Creating a BCV Plot
plotBCV(sf)
```


## Smear plot
```{r}
#exact test for differential expression
et <- exactTest(sf, pair=c("N","T"))

summary(de <- decideTestsDGE(et))
#D. Visualizing Differentially Expressed Genes
detags <- rownames(sf)[as.logical(de)]
plotSmear(et, de.tags=detags)
abline(h=c(-1, 1), col="blue")
```

```{r}
##Viewing a List of Differentially Expressed Genes
diffExpGenes <- topTags(et, n=1000, p.value = 0.05)
```

## Design matrix
```{r}
Patient <- factor(c(8,8,33,33,51,51))
Tissue <- factor(c("N","T","N","T","N","T"))
design <- model.matrix(~Patient+Tissue)
rownames(design) <- colnames(sf)
design
```
## Smear plot (generalized linear model)

```{r}
#B. Calculating the Dispersion
disp_calc <- sf
disp_calc <- estimateDisp(disp_calc, design, robust=TRUE)


#C. Differential Expression Analysis with the GLM

fit <- glmFit(disp_calc, design)
lrt <- glmLRT(fit, coef=4)
summary(de2 <- decideTestsDGE(lrt))

#plot of log fold change
detags <- rownames(disp_calc)[as.logical(de2)]
plotSmear(lrt, de.tags=detags)
abline(h=c(-1, 1), col="blue")

#D. Viewing a List of Differentially Expressed Genes in the GLM
```
